corrections.reason: In the Classical Ge'ez citation (ውእቱ አሚረ ይትራከብ ዘርዕ ምስለ ማእረር ወየኀብር ሠርፅ ምስለ ቀሥም), the imperfect verb is ወየኀብር ('and it joins/unites'), with 1st-order የ rather than 7th-order ዮ.
In the patristic Ge'ez quote (ወኀበ አርዌ ምድር ቄዐ ኀምዞ በኢሰሚዕ), the noun is ኀምዞ ('its venom/poison', from ኀምዝ with pronominal suffix -ኦ), where ኀ was misread as ጎ.
The Amharic word is ወፍ ('bird': ምፅ የሚጸናባት ወፍ አለች 'there is a bird whose labor pains are severe'). Slight ink wear on the left curve of ወ caused it to be misread as የ.
A visible word-separator colon (፡) is printed at the end of line 24 after እንተ.
